task.text_type: semi-formal e-mail in reply to an advertisement
task.guiding_points_to_cover: three of the four, or two plus one further aspect of your own

band_summaries.A: three guiding points, or two plus one further aspect related to the situation, handled appropriately at the target level
band_summaries.B: two guiding points, or one plus one further aspect
band_summaries.C: one guiding point or one further aspect
band_summaries.D: no guiding point and no further aspect

band_summaries.A: B2 well met (upper range of the target level)
band_summaries.C: one level below the target level
band_summaries.D: two or more levels below the target level

special_rules.rule: If the text has no or hardly any connection to the writing task, D is given for all criteria.
If only the situation is missed, criterion I is D, but criteria II and III are still assessed.
If criterion III is D, criteria I and II can still be C, B or A.
Appropriate treatment of a guiding point or freely chosen aspect requires more than a single complex sentence.
A is not given for criterion II if the features of a (semi-)formal message (subject line, salutation, closing formula) are missing and the vocabulary range is not fully appropriate.
B is not given for criterion II if the wrong register is chosen or fluctuates, the vocabulary range is not appropriate for B2, or the guiding points are listed linearly without logical connection.
All writing conventions of standard varieties of German are accepted, including capitalisation rules.

sources.supports: explanations and band rules per criterion
point table A/B/C/D = 5/3/1/0, sum multiplied by three, maximum 45
test format: one task chosen from two, Minimum 150 Wörter, 45 points = 15 %
